title: Bar Gelila
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Shabbat 80b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.80b.5), he came to Babylonia and was asked to expound the Account of the Chariot. He replied, “I will expound for you as Rabbi Nechemyah expounded.” Hyman explains that this is not a personal name but means a man of Galilee.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman explains Bar Gelila as a Galilean designation, not a personal name.
The linked text uses “a certain Galilean” and gives Rabbi Nechemyah as the sage whose exposition he says he will follow.
